name: Gyroscope GYD
who_can_redeem: Users of supported Gyroscope protocol routes may mint and redeem GYD through protocol smart contracts and bonding-curve mechanisms.
redemption_region_notes: Interface, jurisdiction, network, and reserve-asset conditions may apply.
redemption_notes: Base GYD is separate from yield-bearing sGYD and from historical Polygon Gyro Proto representations.
summary: Gyroscope reserve-backed protocol dollar using a diversified reserve basket and automated pricing and risk controls.
notes: Batch M. Ethereum mainnet launch date is supported by an official dated announcement.

name: f(x) Protocol fxUSD
who_can_redeem: Users may mint or redeem through supported f(x) Protocol collateral-position and stability mechanisms.
redemption_region_notes: Interface, oracle, collateral, liquidity, and network conditions apply.
redemption_notes: Base fxUSD is separate from fxSAVE, xPOSITION, sPOSITION, stability-pool shares, and CreditNotes.
summary: f(x) Protocol stablecoin backed by onchain collateral positions and supported by protocol stability mechanisms.
notes: Batch M. The canonical public-availability boundary is 2024-02-27, after the official seeding phase began and an Ethereum Curve pool containing fxUSD was created on-chain. The January announcement and February 23 seeding start are not used as the launch date. f(x) Protocol V2 upgraded the same fxUSD proxy on 2025-01-02; V2 is recorded as a protocol upgrade rather than a new asset launch.

name: Berachain HONEY
who_can_redeem: Users may mint and redeem HONEY against supported collateral through Berachain protocol routes.
redemption_region_notes: Collateral availability, fees, Basket Mode, interface, and network conditions apply.
redemption_notes: Base HONEY is separate from vault receipts, liquidity positions, and bridged representations.
summary: Berachain-native fully collateralized stablecoin minted against governance-whitelisted stablecoin collateral vaults.
notes: Batch M. Mainnet launch is known at year level; exact day remains unresolved.

name: QiDAO MAI
who_can_redeem: Vault borrowers may repay MAI to release collateral, and supported Peg Stability Modules provide mint and queued redemption routes.
redemption_region_notes: Chain, bridge, vault, liquidity, module, and interface conditions apply.
redemption_notes: MAI is the renamed continuation of miMATIC; chain-specific deployments require explicit canonicality review.
summary: QiDAO multi-chain overcollateralized stablecoin issued through crypto vaults and supported Peg Stability Modules.
notes: Batch M. Canonical public-availability launch is the official Polygon borrowing guide published on 2021-05-02, which documents an operating protocol, MAI borrowing, and a live debt ceiling. MAI is the continuing stablecoin previously called miMATIC. The exact rename day and exact V2 production activation remain unresolved.

name: Stables Labs USDX
who_can_redeem: Approved entities may use direct mint and redemption routes; other holders rely on market liquidity.
redemption_region_notes: Identity, jurisdiction, counterparty, liquidity, settlement, and compliance restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: Official documentation describes direct redemption into USDT after a seven-day period. Base USDX is separate from sUSDX.
summary: Stables Labs synthetic dollar backed by a delta-neutral crypto spot and derivatives portfolio.
notes: Batch M. The record is disambiguated from unrelated assets using the USDX symbol.
